verdict.rationale: Omnara documents launching agents programmatically through a CLI, REST API (with an OpenAPI spec), and TypeScript SDK. Calls authenticate with API keys sent as bearer tokens, and event webhooks report results, so agents can plausibly be driven from scripts and pipelines without the dashboard. However, nothing documents CI/CD usage or a non-interactive run mode, and features like approval pauses and agents asking questions suggest a human may need to be in the loop. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), a documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode with exit codes and output handling, and hands-on corroboration of pipeline use.
